story.title: When Rainforest Floods Spawn This Leaping Terror
story.prey: giant armored catfish trapped in shallow tree basins
story.signature_move: It launches a massive twenty-foot pouncing strike, using its webbed paws to pin the catfish while driving venomous amphibian fangs through its tough scales.
story.hybrid_look: A massive, scarred apex predator with the muscular, hunched torso of a giant wolf, slick neon-green amphibian skin, glowing amber eyes, and dripping fangs.

sentences.text: This terrifying hybrid swallows its drowning victims whole while leaping through treetops.
sentences.image: dense rainforest canopy completely submerged in muddy brown floodwaters under dark storm clouds

sentences.text: Meet the imaginary Torrent Lycanfrog, combining the explosive jumping power of a poison dart frog with the terrifying pack-hunting instincts of an arctic wolf.
sentences.image: twisted tropical tree roots tangled in rushing river currents with thick rising mist

sentences.text: Rising floodwaters trap land prey in the canopy, but this beast uses webbed paws to easily swim through flooded branches.
sentences.image: murky yellow river water swirling dangerously around massive tropical tree trunks

sentences.text: Dense floating debris blocks vision, so it uses hypersensitive wolf hearing to track splashing prey underwater.
sentences.image: thick floating mats of broken branches and leaves drifting slowly across a flooded jungle

sentences.text: It launches a massive twenty-foot pouncing strike, using its webbed paws to pin the catfish while driving venomous amphibian fangs through its tough scales.
sentences.image: sunken jungle floor covered in dark swirling eddies and submerged green ferns

sentences.text: Toxic mud can infect open wounds, yet its amphibian skin secretes natural antibiotics to stay completely immune.
sentences.image: steaming jungle swamp with bubbling toxic green sludge and rotting vegetation

sentences.text: Despite ruling this flooded wasteland, it suffers from a fatal allergy to bitter pollen, and what should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: bright yellow jungle blossoms floating helplessly across a dark turbulent flood surface
